glosses: authority (the power to enforce rules or give orders)
authority (a person accepted as a source of reliable information on a subject)

examples.text: Han dado parte a las autoridades.
examples.en: They reported it to the authorities.

examples.text: Tom no tiene respeto por las autoridades.
examples.en: Tom has no respect for authority.

examples.text: Él es una autoridad en física.
examples.en: He is an authority on physics.
